title: Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement
description:
Reports to: VP, Sales Enablement 

About Axiom

Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement translates commercial technology, sales processes, AI-enabled workflows, and Axiom's AI-enabled client solutions into practical ways of working for sellers and managers. This role serves as the Enablement lead for the commercial technology ecosystem: helping the field use core sales technologies and AI to work more effectively, while partnering with Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions leaders to build field readiness to position Axiom's evolving AI solutions. The role partners closely with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, IT, Marketing, Product, Technology & Talent, and sales leadership to ensure sellers and managers can leverage internal technology and AI effectively and confidently bring Axiom's AI-enabled solutions into client conversations.

The role does not own enterprise system administration or design Axiom's client AI solutions. It owns the field activation layer: understanding the seller experience, translating technology, process, and solution capabilities into clear seller and manager behaviors, building the enablement experience, and measuring whether the field can use internal tools and position Axio

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

title: Business Development Representative (North America)

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Revenue team and help us expand Filigran’s footprint across the North America region. Your mission is to identify, engage, and qualify new enterprise opportunities — fueling our growth by connecting security leaders with Filigran’s open-source and commercial solutions.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to turn market interest into meaningful conversations, driving the pipeline that powers Filigran’s mission to make cyber defense more proactive and connected.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and engage potential enterprise customers across the NA region.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About the role

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Client ownership after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical and operational contact for newly onboarded clients.
  • Act as the main stakeholder on integration channels after go-live, picking up operational requests and routing anything commercial to the Account Manager.
  • Monitor the period after go-live for latency and early signs of problems that would affect a successful launch, and escalate before the client reports them.
  • Manage key accounts from an operational perspective, supporting clients through changes to their setup.

Operational configuration and change

  • Own financial limit changes and RTP updates, applying the current Booming standards and escalating any request that falls outside them.
  • Own tournament configuration where this sits with Customer Success rather than with the Account Manager.
  • Handle general client requests such as media files and thumbnails, which clients may now request directly from the TAM.
  • Handle setup changes: new currencies, new configurations, account migrations and account splits.

title: Werkstudent:in (m/w/d) - Projektierung & Umsetzung, Batteriespeicher (BESS)
description:
Du studierst Elektrotechnik oder Energietechnik und willst an echten Industriespeicher-Projekten arbeiten statt an Übungsaufgaben? Dann lies weiter. 🔋

⚡ ÜBER FION

Die europäische Industrie verliert an Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, weil Strom hier teurer und volatiler ist als in den USA oder China. Der Grund: Erneuerbare schwanken stark – Fabriken verbrauchen konstant.

Wir lösen dieses Ungleichgewicht: FION plant und installiert für Industriestandorte das passende Batteriesystem und steuert es mit KI in Echtzeit über Tarife und Märkte. Das Ergebnis: deutlich niedrigere Energiekosten und messbare CO₂-Einsparungen. Wir arbeiten bereits mit mehreren Industrieunternehmen zusammen und werden von Early-Stage-Investoren unterstützt.

🎯 DEINE ROLLE

Unser Projektportfolio wächst schnell – und mit ihm die Projektierungs- und Umsetzungsarbeit-Arbeit hinter jedem Batteriespeicherprojekt: Planung, Netzanschluss, Dokumentation, Tools. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Delivery & Operations Lead und hältst den Projektbetrieb mit am Laufen – mit echter Verantwortung ab Tag 1.

Du siehst dabei den kompletten Lebenszyklus eines Industriespeicherprojekts: von der Auslegung über den Netzanschluss bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

Aufgaben

✅ Planung & Auslegung von BESS-Projekten: Aufstellpläne, technische Zeichnungen, Dimensionierung von Komponenten (Kabel, Schutztechnik, NA-Schutz)

✅ Mitarbeit an Netzanschlussanträgen nach VDE-AR-N 4110 (u. a. E.1/E.8-Formulare) – du lernst den kompletten Prozess von innen kennen

✅ Pflege von CRM (Pipedrive) und Projektmanagement, Dokumentation in Notion

✅ Recherche & Aufbereitung von Normen (VDE-AR-N, IEC) und Industrie-Trends

✅ Planungstools und Vorlagen mit aufbauen (z. B. Pläne-Automatisierung, Formular-Workflows) – deine Ideen fließen direkt ein

✅ Optional: Erstansprache von Elektrofachbetrieben für Projektins

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region.

This is not purely an advisory role.
